messages:
frank: quick sync on pin/rollout metadata: i sketched a tiny "stability manifest" shape that pushes pin intent to the control plane while giving runtime a deterministic candidate order and a small epoch counter. want quick eyes on precedence rules and tenant overrides.

maya: can you paste the example? runtime needs to know which fields are fast-path.

frank: pasted below. main goals: 1) clients pick a candidate without extra compatibility RPCs, 2) runtime can read top-level hints, 3) admins get telemetry to slice regressions.

```json
{
  "artifact": "auth-encoder-8b",
  "stamp": "r2026-05-01",
  "stamp_seq": 4,
  "fingerprint": "sha256:beefdead...",
  "candidates": [
    {"kind":"hash","id":"sha256:aa22","profile":"fp16","prio":0},
    {"kind":"stamp","id":"r2026-04-27","profile":"int8","prio":1}
  ],
  "fallback": "ordered",
  "soft_ttl": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z",
  "runtime_hint_seq": 512,
  "runtime_annotations": ["placement:prefer-short-seq"],
  "origin_tag": "user-rollout",
  "pin_policy": "soft"
}
```

frank: notes: `stamp_seq` is the cache-invalidator; clients must re-resolve when control-plane seq > local. `fingerprint` is required when hashes are present so we can alert on remaps. `pin_policy` indicates control-plane intent (soft/hard/gradual).

oliver: two practical asks: (A) define precedence: tenant_override (hard pin) > pin_policy > default. call it out explicitly so Dedicated tenants can opt into immutability. (B) add a compact telemetry field `origin_tag` so SRE can slice by canary/auto-migration/user.

maya: also recommend a small `rollforward_seconds` (e.g. 60-300s) so runtime can optimistically try newer candidates in a canary window before falling back; keep validator cap at 3600s.

schema-bot: schema-lint: validator complained about `runtime_hint_seq` name vs `preferred_seq_len` in docs; opened INF-7007 to standardize naming.

frank: i'll harmonize names to `preferred_seq_len` top-level and add `stamp_epoch` alias for `stamp_seq` in the appendix to ease migration. will document tenant_override semantics (hard pin + pin_ttl) and operator alerts on fingerprint diffs.

maya: one more: clients should treat `candidates` as authoritative order only when `stamp_epoch` matches; otherwise re-resolve. keep client code tiny.

oliver: action items: frank update appendix with precedence table, name harmonization, and rollforward guidance (ETA today). maya write client-side bullet list for cheap implementation (ETA tomorrow). i'll add the telemetry slice to observability dashboard (ETA 3 days). schema-bot: re-run on merge.

schema-bot: INF-7007 tracked. re-run schema tests after updates.

maya: ok to merge once frank's edits land; thanks! :+1:
